rationale: mean-reversion.md's Bollinger Bands section: short at upper band / long at lower band, targeting reversion to the mid-band, with stop and target both expressed in std units. ES chosen for lower/smoother volatility per es-futures.md; zero-param trend guard added to address mean-reversion.md's own top pitfall (fading a strong trend).
reasoning: IS CAGR is negative so the OOS/IS efficiency ratio is not meaningful and was not computed. Absolute OOS metrics all fail the vault thresholds: Sharpe -3.55 (vs >0.8 aim), profit factor 0.429 (vs >1.2 aim). OOS trades (477) clear the rule-of-30 easily but only confirm the loss is statistically real, not noise. OOS max drawdown (-0.4264) roughly equals OOS total return (-0.4257) -- the strategy's entire lifetime return is erased by its own drawdown. Fold parameter stability is fine (3 distinct values per param across 65 folds) but moot given the strategy loses money in-sample already, before any generalization gap.

rationale: Volatility-normalized momentum thrust (n-bar return / (ATR(n)*sqrt(n))) with a crossing entry (not a level) and ATR-scaled stop/target, on NQ 1h. Designed to invert iteration 1's failure mode: iteration 1 died purely of turnover cost (477 trades at 0.102% round-trip ≈ the entire -42.6% OOS loss); this idea targets few, highly selective entries with a ~9:1 gross-move-to-cost ratio instead of iteration 1's ~2:1.
reasoning: Efficiency ratio 0.028 (IS CAGR positive, so computable) is an order of magnitude below the vault's <0.3 'likely overfit, reject' band. Confirmed independently: OOS Sharpe 0.021 fails the >0.8 aim, OOS profit factor 1.012 fails the >1.2 aim; only OOS trade count (67) clears rule-of-30. Fold param stability is fine (4/2/3/3 distinct values across 30 folds) but not load-bearing given the ratio isn't borderline. OOS max drawdown (-4.07%) is ~56x the OOS total return (+0.07%) -- all risk taken for essentially no return. Coverage caveat: strategy only traded in 19/30 OOS windows, 8 of which (42%) were profitable, below the vault's >60% OOS-window win-rate aim. Usable run, did not clear the bar -- rejected, not error.
